title: Foreign provider and upstream ooRexxPython boundary
summary: Photo World dev21 retains historical Macrospace qualification, while new Python-provider development must use the upstream ooRexxPython adapter; Maths remains numerical authority and Photo World remains reconstruction authority.
invariants: No subprocess/JSON substitute for the live object model.
Maths-owned objects may cross live into Python; Python need not invent a competing tensor/matrix authority.
OpenCV LSD currently returns only primitive straight-segment observations.
Depth Anything V2 may supply soft depth evidence only.
GeoCLIP may supply geographic candidates only.
PyMeshLab may process candidate meshes only.
Macrospace v0.31.x is retained as historical qualification evidence for dev21, not as an active native development line.
New bridge qualification must use upstream ooRexxPython through the Alchemy adapter and must not inherit the old Macrospace PASS.

current_bridge.runtime_gate: ooRexx 5.3.0 r13265+ for upstream thread tests

provenance.claim: Historical dev21 live-object crossing and provider boundary.
Current Alchemy policy retires the Macrospace native line and delegates native bridge authority upstream.
